The best way to promote an artist or band is by creating a memorable visual aesthetic. Everything an artist releases needs to have a visual theme, from the logo to the album artwork, to the music videos that accompany singles. It's also critical for an artist or band to have a strong social media presence. To get a fanbase, one of the best ways is to provide free downloads of new music, free merchandise, and entertaining visuals. Any other way of promoting an artist, from a website to tour dates to a random radio appearance, all of these complementary images are the "tools" one needs to put bands and artists in the eye of their ideal demographic and allow them to collaborate with different creative types.
